svg.title: Next-door doubles
svg.desc: StrictMath.exp(1) is 2.7182818284590455 and Math.E is 2.718281828459045. Their bits are 4005bf0a8b14576a and 4005bf0a8b145769; they differ in the last 2 bits, and as numbers they are neighbours.
